2610.12247.title: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
2610.12247.paper_summary: Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.
2610.12247.paper_summary_zh: 拓撲深度學習將基於圖的學習擴展到更高階的領域，例如超圖、細胞和單純複形。這些領域通常是通過圖提升的過程從輸入圖中的模式構建而成。全域訓練在模型執行之前構建並存儲完整的提升表示。在像 Reddit（233k 節點和 57.3M 邊）這樣的大型密集數據集上，這種全域實現成為一個嚴重的計算瓶頸，通常使訓練變得不可行。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了 Cluster-TNN，一個領域無關的框架，通過局部提升來避免這一瓶頸。在預處理過程中對輸入圖進行分區後，Cluster-TNN 在運行時動態抽樣節點集群的組，重建它們的誘導子圖以形成小批次，並在每個小批次內應用所選的提升。保留抽樣節點之間的所有邊緣保留了構建跨集群的高階結構所需的連通性，生成現有拓撲神經網絡可以直接處理的拓撲小批次。在與全圖執行的 21 次匹配比較中，Cluster-TNN 在每個配置中均降低了峰值 GPU 記憶體，平均降低 83.2%，同時保持競爭性的預測性能。值得注意的是，這樣的減少使我們能夠首次在大型數據集如 Reddit 和 OGBN 產品上訓練多個不同的高階拓撲神經網絡。這些結果確立了 Cluster-TNN 作為一種通用策略，能夠將拓撲深度學習擴展超越全域領域構建的限制。
